commentary_title: VLGC earnings to remain under stress amid vessel oversupply.
commentary_summary: VLGC earnings on the benchmark US-Japan route fell 5% WoW while on AG-Japan route declined 13% WoW. | The recent winter storm in the US disrupted loadings at terminals, causing buildup of tonnage and exerted downward pressure on rates. | As vessels ballasted towards the Middle East to mitigate the situation, an oversupply near the Gulf pressurised spot rates on AG- Japan route. | This shift in export source impacted tonne-miles demand, resulting in a 7% WoW drop in the tonne-miles index to 116.6 points. | Laden tonnage at anchor in China decreased sharply this week as the country entered the Lunar New year holidays.
